MID360.extrinsic_note: driver JSON extrinsics are zero; inverted mounts are applied once via TF

Odin.config_file_ros_parameter_note: driver source chooses package share/config/control_command.yaml; config_file is a launch override but is absent from declared live parameters
Odin.nav2_uses: odometry_highfreq/IMU via odom_relay; Odin cloud is not a cloud_to_scan input

cluster.note: startup log says min 4; executable condition is sizes < 5

processing.odom_conversion: source linear velocity is world-frame; rotate to source body, apply TF lever-arm pose/twist/covariance conversion to base_link; preserve source stamp; age gate [-0.05,0.3] s
processing.scan: LaserScan base_link, 0.5 degree bin, -pi..pi radians, oldest accepted input stamp, 0.3 s cloud age; scan_time metadata 0.1 s, range_min 0, range_max 1e6 (not physical sensor range)
processing.map: OccupancyGrid odom, 0.05 m resolution, 10 m rolling window, 0.4 s history, 0.3 s max_age; self-echo [-0.38,0.82,-0.35,0.35] m; side/rear blind_band 0.1 m is policy free space, not measured visibility

velocity_interface.inverse_formula: x=-w/(8*TURN_GAIN); y=v/(8*(FORWARD_GAIN if v>=0 else REVERSE_GAIN)); divide x,y by max(1,hypot(x,y))
velocity_interface.screen_coordinates: calibrated bottom-right boundary origin; +x right, +y down; center [-16,-19] HID counts, not pixels/metres
velocity_interface.hid_quantization: map_input supports substeps 1 or 25; fine_hid_enabled=true and supported=true in status

dds.note: task-owned staged Cyclone libraries are required on this host; /opt/ros/humble alone could not load this RMW. Source dds_profile.env for consistent read-only discovery. Sensor UDP IPs are distinct from ROS DDS domain.

eye_interface.legacy_hardware_wrapper_dds: sets EYE_ROS_DOMAIN_ID to WHEELCHAIR_ROS_DOMAIN_ID default 0 and EYE_ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY; does not explicitly force current staged Cyclone RMW
eye_interface.eye_calibration: default start performs per-start center calibration; --three-point selects saved profile; no active eye process or calibration loaded was verified; no physical gaze alignment to Odin or Nav2 inferred
eye_interface.nav2_exposed_input: /goal_pose geometry_msgs/PoseStamped in odom; /navigate_to_pose nav2_msgs/action/NavigateToPose; gaze-to-goal/action adapter not wired in inspected profiles

uncertainties: Observed Odin USB detach and missing sensor streams; eno1 DOWN and no MID360/Odin/scan messages in the four-second read-only window. Current fresh frame IDs, frequency, synchronization, physical alignment and data quality cannot be validated.

Static translations and rotations are configured values verified against latched TF, not newly measured mechanical calibration. Odin base-to-imu and base-to-lidar deliberately share the same identity rotation and translation; their physical coincidence is not independently measured here.

Odin runtime calib file path is established by driver source plus process environment; runtime/source/install copies have identical hashes. No CALIB load line was recovered from the service journal, so in-memory calibration bytes were not directly read back.
camera_0 TF is hardcoded to six decimal places in launch, derived in comments from Tcl_0; changing calib.yaml does not automatically update this TF.

Running processes predate the source relocation and latched-arm patch. navigation_latched_arm is absent from the running node parameter list, although current launch specifies latched_arm:=true. Current disk SHA is not an in-memory Python module SHA.

The four-second graph snapshot covers domain 0 on this Jetson; no eye integration was observed. It does not establish availability of eye cameras, user calibration or an independently running detector on another DDS domain.

Legacy eye hardware launch selects its own shared-control stack and Ble2WChair overlay; it is not an adapter that automatically connects gaze to these three Nav2 profiles. Event-to-Nav2 authority/action adapter is not present in these profile entry points.

Source reorganization and simulation work are concurrent user activities. Each evidence file has a timestamp; this inventory is not an atomic filesystem snapshot and does not certify post-relocation build or simulation success.
Nav2 source trees contain local changes; Git HEAD alone is not a full content identity. The manifest hashes inspected dependency files, not every Nav2 source file or a complete reproducible build.
Velocity map coefficients and HID coordinates are configured/model values; no physical response, braking, slip, fine-HID resolution or closed-loop velocity validation was performed.
